basics.summary: Full Stack Software Engineer with 7+ years of experience designing, building, and shipping web applications, workflow automation, and REST/GraphQL APIs using Node.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, React.js, and PostgreSQL. Currently at Esko R&D, building and maintaining 50+ Enfocus Switch automation apps that cut manual intervention by 60%. Experienced across the full software development lifecycle (SDLC), including requirements, architecture, development, testing, CI/CD, cloud deployment (AWS, Heroku), and release management in Agile teams.

projects.name: Enfocus Switch Apps – Workflow Automation Platform (Desktop)
highlights: Built and migrated 50+ workflow automation apps for the Enfocus Switch App Store using Node.js, TypeScript, and the Enfocus SDK, owning the full app lifecycle and delivering releases on schedule.
Designed and maintained automated prepress workflows that reduced manual intervention by 60% and improved production efficiency.
Reduced customer job onboarding time from 45 minutes to under 10 minutes (~78%) through tailored Switch App automation.
Integrated Switch with third-party services using RESTful APIs, webhooks, FTP servers, MIS systems, and hot folders.
Engineered prepress automation features including file validation, preflight, renaming, compression/decompression, split/merge, approval workflows, file sharing, and email notifications.
Evaluated, installed, and configured community and commercial Enfocus App Store apps to extend core Switch platform functionality.
Managed source control and CI builds with Perforce, GitHub, and Jenkins, working with AWS cloud services.

projects.name: Johnson Controls – Contract Management Platform (Web Application)
highlights: Developed full-stack features for a large-scale enterprise contract management application covering contract creation, pricing, booking, approvals, reporting, and service maintenance.
Built the pricing module, implementing pricing, margin, and profit calculation business logic.
Developed contract maintenance and auto-renewal workflows across multiple microservices.
Built optimized, responsive React.js UI components and authored GraphQL schemas and queries for new features.
Designed REST API endpoints and server-side logic in Node.js and Express.js following MVC architecture; maintained PostgreSQL databases.
Enhanced reporting features for the client documentation process.
Deployed and hosted the application on Heroku; handled regression testing, bug fixes, and Git (Bitbucket) version control.

projects.name: Online Examination Portal – Recruitment Assessment Platform (Web Application)
highlights: Built a full-stack recruitment assessment platform with separate Candidate and Admin portals to replace traditional hiring tests.
Developed the candidate exam interface and admin features for exam management, permissions, bulk and manual user management, question set upload, and assessment control.
Created reusable higher-order and generic React.js components (tables, cards, forms) for a responsive, scalable UI.
Built REST APIs and server logic with Node.js, Express.js, and PostgreSQL using MVC architecture.
Worked in Agile sprints with Jira, maintained the CI/CD workflow, and managed Heroku deployments.
